project_type: Python Manim-based YouTube video production system with AI pipeline
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml, Makefile for production commands
test_framework: pytest (tests/ directory, not yet created), ruff for linting
build_command: pip install -e '.[dev]' && ruff check . && ruff format --check .
verification_instructions: 1. Run ruff check . 2. Run ruff format --check . 3. Run pytest tests/ -v if tests exist 4. Verify produce.py --help works 5. Verify produce.py --dry-run works with a topic
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET available. pyenv with Python 3.12.13. No Manim rendering possible (no display/LaTeX). AI stages need LLM API - use placeholder/mock for now. FFmpeg available via apt.
contribution_requirements: Branch from feat/project-scaffold. Never commit to main directly. Use conventional commits. All code must pass ruff check and ruff format. Pipeline scripts are standalone CLI tools with argparse. Use pathlib.Path for file ops. Type hints on function signatures. Docstrings on public functions.
key_patterns: pipeline/ scripts are standalone CLI tools invoked via Makefile. Each has argparse with --help. studio/ is the reusable Manim library. videos/ contains one folder per video with standardized structure. Use yaml.safe_load() for YAML. Use X | None not Optional[X].
directory_structure: studio/ = reusable Manim library (4 modules). pipeline/ = CLI automation scripts. assets/ = shared SVGs/fonts/music. prompts/ = AI prompt templates. videos/ = one folder per video (numbered). output/ = rendered output (gitignored). .kiro/steering/ = 6 steering files governing all decisions.
